newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.011 bln stg week to March 12.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.011 bln stg week to March 12.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.011 billion sterling in the week to March 12 from 25.008 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis M0 rose to 24.486 billion sterling from 24.451 billion the week before.
Notes and coins in circulation dipped slightly to 24.828 billion sterling from 24.889 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis and slipped unadjusted to 24.303 billion from 24.332 billion sterling.
